name: J. A. Rea
role: Register of the Bismarck land office
bio: J. A. Rea was register of the land office at Bismarck, and his name was signed to the homestead contest notices the Cow Boy printed through the summer of 1884. In July 1885 he and Territorial Secretary J. H. Teller visited Medora and left well impressed with the Bad Lands. At the Fourth of July celebration at Dickinson in 1886, he and Theodore Roosevelt were the speakers, Rea speaking first.
